reference.observation: Ambient typography and explicit host direction align Native ConfigProvider. Native flat input/action structure and geometry adapters, number/string parsing and form/reset contracts remain. Comparisons use common root/input/action styles in stringMode; Source FormData retains edited text while Native hidden field retains canonical decimal value. Deprecated addons excluded. Source rc-component/input-number 1.6.2 emits -focused while Source action CSS expects -mode-input-focused. Raw focused action metrics remain unmodified; expectedNative is measured with public className supplying that missing class. Native retains its pre-existing focused mode class and visible actions.
